cd /tmp/obench-cell-bxx6m3yu/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_mun8txyw; python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv'); b=pd.read_csv('test_out/demo_metadata.csv')
print("cols same", a.columns.tolist()==b.columns.tolist(), "rows", len(a), len(b))
print("other cols same", (a.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])==b.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])).all().all())
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); rect=0; bad=0; ious=[]
vis=img.copy()
for (_,r),(_,o) in zip(b.iterrows(),a.iterrows()):
    xs=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
    assert xs.min()==r.xmin and xs.max()==r.xmax and ys.min()==r.ymin and ys.max()==r.ymax
    assert xs.max()<W and ys.max()<H and xs.min()>=0 and ys.min()>=0
    if len(set(xs))<=2 and len(set(ys))<=2: rect+=1
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32)],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=8)
    if n!=2: bad+=1
    cnt+=m
    ox=np.array(list(map(int,o.coords_x.split(','))));oy=np.array(list(map(int,o.coords_y.split(','))))
    om=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(om,[np.stack([ox,oy],1).astype(np.int32)],1)
    ious.append(((m&om).sum()/((m|om).sum()), o.type, m.sum(), om.sum()))
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(np.int32)],True,(0,255,0),1)
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([ox,oy],1).astype(np.int32)],True,(0,0,255),1)
print("rect",rect,"noncontig",bad,"overlap px",(cnt>1).sum())
for t in ['polyline','rectangle']:
    v=[x for x in ious if x[1]==t]; print(t, "mean IoU w/ orig", np.mean([x[0] for x in v]).round(3), "min", min(x[0] for x in v).round(3))
big=cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST); cv2.imwrite('test_out/vis.png',big)
EOF
